World AI Summit 2026 session

Arif Khan spoke at the first edition, World AI Summit 2025 in Bengaluru. The 2026 line-up is being announced. World AI Summit 2026 takes place on 14-15 October 2026 at Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India. See the agenda.

About Arif Khan

A seasoned leader with over 17 years of experience in the payments industry and digital channels, Arif Khan brings a strong track record of driving innovation and delivering impactful technology solutions. Before Razorpay he played pivotal roles at HDFC Bank, Mastercard and PwC, leading the development of transformative financial products and services, with deep expertise in large-scale digital transformation.
